lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa and George are playing at Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's house.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在猪奶奶和猪爷爷家玩。

lines.en: Grandpa, catch!
lines.zh: 爷爷，接住！

lines.en: What's this? Dinosaur.
lines.zh: 这是什么？恐龙。

lines.en: Grandpa, what are you doing? I'm planting these seeds.
lines.zh: 爷爷，你在做什么？我在种这些种子。

lines.en: Seeds? What do seeds do?
lines.zh: 种子？种子是做什么的？

lines.en: Seeds grow into plants.
lines.zh: 种子会长成植物。

lines.en: I just make a little hole and put the seed in. Then I cover it with earth and water it.
lines.zh: 我先挖一个小坑，把种子放进去。然后盖上土，再浇水。

lines.en: Everything in my garden grows from tiny seeds like these.
lines.zh: 我花园里的每一样东西，都是从这样的小种子长出来的。

lines.en: Even the big apple tree?
lines.zh: 连那棵大苹果树也是吗？

lines.en: Oh, yes. This tiny apple seed will grow into a little apple tree, like this.
lines.zh: 哦，是的。这颗小小的苹果籽会长成一棵小苹果树，就像这样。

lines.en: And that little apple tree will grow into a big apple tree, like this.
lines.zh: 然后那棵小苹果树会长成一棵大苹果树，就像这样。

lines.en: And inside this apple are more seeds, to make more apple trees.
lines.zh: 而这个苹果里面还有更多的籽，可以长出更多的苹果树。

lines.en: Exactly.
lines.zh: 说得对。

lines.en: I want to plant a seed.
lines.zh: 我想种一颗种子。

lines.en: Would you like to plant a strawberry seed?
lines.zh: 你想种一颗草莓种子吗？

lines.en: Yes, please.
lines.zh: 好的，我想种。

lines.en: This seed will grow into a lovely strawberry plant.
lines.zh: 这颗种子会长成一株可爱的草莓。

lines.en: First, make a little hole.
lines.zh: 首先，挖一个小坑。

lines.en: Then I put the seed in and cover it with earth.
lines.zh: 然后我把种子放进去，再盖上土。

lines.en: Shall I water it for you? No. I want to water it.
lines.zh: 要我帮你浇水吗？不用。我想自己浇水。

lines.en: Good. Now we wait for it to grow.
lines.zh: 很好。现在我们就等它长大。

lines.en: Peppa and George are waiting for the seed to grow.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在等种子发芽。

lines.en: It's not doing anything.
lines.zh: 它一点动静都没有。

lines.en: You'll have to be patient, Peppa! It will take a long time to grow.
lines.zh: 佩奇，你得有耐心！它要很长时间才能长大。

lines.en: Peppa, George, it's time to go home.
lines.zh: 佩奇，乔治，该回家了。

lines.en: But we're waiting for my strawberry plant to grow. I wanted strawberries for tea.
lines.zh: 可是我们在等我的草莓长大呢。我还想吃点心的时候吃草莓。

lines.en: Don't worry, Peppa. Next time you come, the seed will have grown into a plant.
lines.zh: 别担心，佩奇。下次你们来的时候，种子就长成植株了。

lines.en: And we'll have strawberries?
lines.zh: 那我们就有草莓了吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 是的。

lines.en: Come on, Peppa. Bye-bye, Grandpa. Bye-bye, Strawberry.
lines.zh: 走吧，佩奇。再见，爷爷。再见，小草莓。

lines.en: Grandpa Pig looks after Peppa's strawberry plant.
lines.zh: 猪爷爷照看着佩奇的草莓。

lines.en: After many days, Grandpa Pig finds a tiny plant growing.
lines.zh: 许多天以后，猪爷爷发现长出了一株小苗。

lines.en: Day by day, the plant grows bigger and bigger.
lines.zh: 一天天过去，植株长得越来越大。

lines.en: And one day, Grandpa Pig finds something very special.
lines.zh: 有一天，猪爷爷发现了一个特别的东西。

lines.en: Strawberries!
lines.zh: 草莓！

lines.en: Grandpa, we're back!
lines.zh: 爷爷，我们回来啦！

lines.en: Grandpa, Grandpa, did my plant grow? Yes. Look.
lines.zh: 爷爷，爷爷，我的植株长大了吗？是的。你看。

lines.en: Strawberries!
lines.zh: 草莓！

lines.en: Thank you, Grandpa!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，爷爷！

lines.en: Grandpa, can we plant something else?
lines.zh: 爷爷，我们可以再种点别的东西吗？

lines.en: Yes. Now it's George's turn to choose.
lines.zh: 可以。现在轮到乔治来选了。

lines.en: Choose a carrot.
lines.zh: 选胡萝卜吧。

lines.en: Grandpa, I think George wants to grow a carrot.
lines.zh: 爷爷，我觉得乔治想种胡萝卜。

lines.en: George, would you like to grow a carrot?
lines.zh: 乔治，你想种胡萝卜吗？

lines.en: No! What would you like to grow?
lines.zh: 不要！那你想种什么呢？

lines.en: George has thought of something he wants to grow.
lines.zh: 乔治想到了他想种的东西。

lines.en: Dinosaur!
lines.zh: 恐龙！

lines.en: George wants to grow a dinosaur tree.
lines.zh: 乔治想种一棵恐龙树。

lines.en: Silly George. Dinosaurs don't grow on trees.
lines.zh: 傻乔治。恐龙不是长在树上的。
